paragraphs: The XF 3.0 V6 S/SC is one of the high-performance petrol options from the X250 generation, which ran from 2007 to 2015. It uses the AJ126 engine - a 3.0-litre supercharged V6 that was also used across various Jaguar Land Rover products of the same era, including the XJ, F-Type, and Range Rover Sport. The "S" and "SC" designations refer to the supercharged variants, offering more power than the naturally aspirated 3.0 V6, and making this one of the most desirable petrol XFs of its time. The XF 3.0 V6 S/SC is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace engine engines for every XF 3.0 V6 S/SC on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre supercharged V6 petrol engine fitted to the XF 3.0 V6 S/SC from 2007 to 2015 (X250 generation). This is a performance-focused engine delivering a significant power uplift over the naturally aspirated 3.0 V6.

compatibility.intro: Because the X250 generation offered such a wide range of engines - from diesel I4s and V6s to naturally aspirated and supercharged V6s and V8s - parts are not interchangeable across the board.
